preconditions.description: The graph has between 1 and 300,000 vertices and between 0 and 300,000 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i < v_i <= n for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges) and all(1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for _, _, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects distinct vertices within the valid range, and each edge weight is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(set((min(u_i, v_i), max(u_i, v_i)) for u_i, v_i, _ in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: There is no more than one edge between any pair of vertices.
The start vertex u is within the valid range of vertices.
The number of edges provided matches the input m.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(total_weight)] + [str(edge_index) for edge_index in selected_edges]
postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is the minimum total weight of the edges in the shortest-path tree, and the second line contains the 1-based indices of the edges included in the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= edge_index <= m for edge_index in selected_edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge index in the output is within the valid range of input edges.

postconditions.expression: len(selected_edges) == n - 1
postconditions.description: The number of edges in the tree is exactly n - 1, forming a spanning tree.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v, _ in [(edges[edge_index - 1][0], edges[edge_index - 1][1]) for edge_index in selected_edges])
postconditions.description: The selected edges are valid and connect distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: total_weight == sum(edges[edge_index - 1][2] for edge_index in selected_edges)
postconditions.description: The total weight is the sum of the weights of the selected edges.

postconditions.expression: all(shortest_path_in_tree(u, v) == shortest_path_in_graph(u, v) for v in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For every vertex v, the shortest path from u to v in the tree matches the shortest path in the original graph.

postconditions.expression: total_weight == min(sum(edges[edge_index - 1][2] for edge_index in candidate_edges) for candidate_edges in possible_shortest_path_trees(u, edges, n))
postconditions.description: The total weight of the selected edges is the minimum possible among all valid shortest-path trees from vertex u.
